# The Unenclosed Knowledge Declaration

> A public manifesto — seven principles against the enclosure of the mind. Initiated by FolkUp, open for signature by any person or organization. Part of the FolkUp ecosystem of open-content publishing.

## About

The Unenclosed Knowledge Declaration is a public manifesto against the growing enclosure of knowledge — paywalls, gated access, algorithmic filtering, artificial scarcity. Seven principles articulate an alternative: knowledge as a commons, open access, transparent attribution, freedom to copy and adapt. Available in English, Russian, Portuguese. Sign electronically — individuals or organizations. Content licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Read and Sign

- [Declaration (English)](https://declaration.folkup.app/): Seven principles + full manifesto text + electronic signature form.
- [Декларация (Русский)](https://declaration.folkup.app/ru/): Полный текст манифеста и семи принципов на русском.
- [Declaração (Português)](https://declaration.folkup.app/pt/): Texto completo do manifesto e dos sete princípios em português.
- [Sign the Declaration](https://declaration.folkup.app/sign): Electronic signature form — individual or organization.
